feature.title: Layout & Appearance

appearance.title: Appearance Settings
appearance.description: Customize the overall look and feel of the application.

color.description: Adjust the theme settings, including brightness, colors, and modes.

mode.title: Theme Mode
mode.description: Choose between Light and Dark theme modes.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Choose a color palette for the application interface.

layout.title: Scale & Layout
layout.description: Customize the application's layout and scaling options.

font.description: Choose a font style for the application.

size.title: Font Size

direction.title: Menu Direction

vertical-mode.title: Vertical Menu Style
vertical-mode.description: Choose compact icons only or full labels for the vertical menu.

badge.title: Show Menu Badges
badge.description: Toggle visibility of notification badges in the menu.

navigation.description: Configure how pages open inside the application.

mode.title: Navigation Mode
mode.description: Choose whether pages replace the current view or open as internal application tabs.

max-open-tabs.title: Open Tab Limit
max-open-tabs.description: Maximum number of internal tabs that can be open at once in tabular mode.

zip-dialog.title: Bundle Files Into ZIP?
zip-dialog.message: You selected {{count}} files. Do you want to combine them into a single ZIP archive?

test10.page-description: Choose files with a custom provider, review the selection, then upload and track the result.
test10.title: Test 10 - Custom File Chooser Provider
test10.description: This page demonstrates a provider-driven file chooser. The custom provider opens a hosted popup and returns generated files.
test10.popup-note: Enter one filename per line. The provider will generate mock files from this list.

sections.choose-hint: Pick a provider — device or drive — then select files.
sections.choose-hooks-hint: Image compression and ZIP bundling follow platform File Chooser settings (Experience → File Chooser).
sections.chosen-empty: No files selected yet. Use the button above to choose files.

test10.title: Test 10 - Custom File Uploader Provider
test10.description: This page demonstrates a provider-driven file uploader. Files are chosen first, then passed to the uploader as chosen items.
test10.popup-note: Enter one filename per line. The provider will generate mock uploaded files from this list.

sections.upload-hint: Pick a destination — device or drive — then upload the selected files.
sections.widget-panel-hint: Entity file-uploader widget in edit mode — add, drag-and-drop, rename, and remove files.
